AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Confetti is a conference schedule app: it lists the sessions of the conference the user has selected and manages the user's session bookmarks. Operational patterns: - 'listSessions' returns the session IDs that 'addBookmark' and 'removeBookmark' take. - All functions act on the currently selected conference, which 'getConference' returns. Constraints: - A conference must already be selected in the app; switching conference is not supported. - Adding or removing bookmarks requires the user to be signed in to Confetti.
